what: On first open, the logo is drawn as strokes in stroke order at the center of a background-color curtain (1.4s sine.inOut, filled dots light up on their turn). It holds for .73s, then flies to the real logo spot in the header, accelerating over .3s power2.in, shrinking to that size and fading to opacity .2, while the curtain lifts in the same .3s. When done, fx:done and a document event named done fire. Hook the header and first title on it to bring them in.

options.[data-fx-part=logo]: Grill logo SVG — paths and circles without fill are drawn as strokes, and filled shapes switch on in their turn
options.to: Place to fly to and land (CSS selector, usually the header logo) — if none, it fades out in place
options.done: Name of the document event fired at the end (attached to headline and title reveal)
options.fade: Opacity when it flies in and lands, default .2 — the real logo takes over
options.--fx-veil / --fx-ink: Curtain background and logo color, default --kf-bg / --kf-ink
options.lead: How many seconds before everything has settled to fire the done event, default 0 (fx:done always fires at the end) — the Brand preset uses .13 (rises just before the first title settles)
options.veil: lift: the cover does not blur but lifts upward along the flight distance and curve (spyker — draw: 1; hold: .2; fly: .9; fly-ease: 0.625,0.05,0,1; fade: 1; veil: lift)

note: The curtain covers the page from the first paint with CSS — it would not clear if the script did not run, so with reduced motion CSS removes the curtain (same convention as the other loader parts). The head line is kept hidden by the consuming side until the done event.

from.where: recruit.html .cr-intro (original careers page hero — on a white veil the Brand logo is drawn like handwriting in the center, flies to the header logo spot and settles, then the title rises, timed from film footage)

shared.js boot() — logo Lottie in the center of the white curtain 1s → .2s pause → shrinks into the header logo spot over .9s as the curtain lifts upward (the original Lottie is replaced by our own Lottie on the site)

index.html white curtain on first open .mo-loading — the original is an APNG (63 frames · 15fps) where the logo strokes are drawn with a brown brush tip leading = 4.2s loop), and once the document is fully loaded, after 2.3s the logo slides up 100px and disappears in 1s Back.easeInOut(1.7), then after 3s the curtain lifts in .8s Power3.easeOut. Motion parts fade in place instead of moving up
